title: The Pentagon’s new cyber mastery incentive model promised a ‘new era.’ Troops are bracing for pay cuts.
summary: While the new program is meant to galvanize cyber skill development through escalating pay rates, the initiative is expected to bring significant pay cuts for cyber troops in at least one branch. Other services struggled to articulate their own rollouts of C-MIP, if they had one at all.
